title: Claire's Inc.
description: About Claire's Inc. Claire's Inc. is a jewelry and accessories retailer aimed at tweens and teens, known for its ear-piercing services and mall-based stores. The company has filed for bankruptcy twice and closed many locations in recent years. It now operates through remaining stores and partnerships with retailers such as Walmart and CVS. Claire's Inc. suffered a cyberattack that disrupted its operations and compromised customers and employees data.
